opening.argument: The video’s focus is a casual meal at Texas Roadhouse. The speaker describes eating with Baby Jane and enjoying loaded steak fries, while the visible plate of steak, sauce and utensils reinforces the restaurant setting. That is the substance of the footage, not a pitch for an investment, credentials, payment or deceptive returns. The retail coupon links are ordinary promotional material in this context. Even the description’s offer to promote products does not change what the video primarily shows: people eating and talking about their food.
